Choose a language profile

A dialect is a compatibility contract, not a cosmetic setting. Import never guesses or changes it; an example explicitly selects its documented profile. Incorrect profiles can change variable names, truth values, INPUT or RNG behavior. Preserve your reference source and choose the appropriate profile first.

Tiny BASICMicrosoft 8KSimple Web BasicTRS-80 Level II

All are bounded subsets. None claims exact hardware memory, timing or historical RNG. Host double precision differs from machine-specific arithmetic. BBC BASIC and a general ROM emulator are outside this version.
